_comment: Recorded model-contract coverage baseline (roadmap step 9). Coverage = soundly-emitted state_dict params / params torch registers. CI asserts current coverage never REGRESSES below these numbers and that emissions stay sound (no false positives). Raising a number is fine (and encouraged as the engine resolves more); lowering it requires a deliberate edit here. Regenerate with: python tests/_torch_oracle.py --emit-baseline (see test_symexec_coverage.py).
